audit.whatIsWrong: diff reads EVEN at 5.5/10 while the win rate is 56.09% and the corrected chart gives Sylas five of seven stages.
audit.why: A 56% win rate with a chart that never favours the enemy is a favoured matchup, not an even one.
audit.corrected: Not edited — the mirror (lillia__sylas) left difficulty at EVEN, and moving only my side would introduce the exact disagreement mirror-fix.js exists to catch. Raised in questionsForUser so both sides can be changed together.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 2, 3 and 6 read Skill against a packet chart of Sylas on all three — and against the page's own whys, which describe level 3 as a rotation that 'beats her burst' and two items as a flex 'she cannot simply kite away from'.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Skill/Skill/Sylas/Sylas/Sylas/Sylas/Sylas and the mirror flipped exactly these three rows with ratings dropped.
audit.corrected: Rows 2, 3 and 6 to Sylas at 4/10 as matched full/content pairs, with the 4-5 and 2+ item whys rewritten to say why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Blooming Blows was described only as 'her kiting speed stacks' — no cooldown, and no mention that its outer ring deals true damage. That omission changes an itemization decision, not just a phrasing one.
audit.why: Kit: Q is 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s and its edge deals extra TRUE damage; Lilting Lullaby is 150/130/110s at 1600 range. The speed stack only builds while she is moving, so her cast animations are the hook windows the page already gestures at without explaining.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and report[5] now carry the Q cadence, the true-damage edge, and the R's 150s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page tells the reader that resistances are the wrong answer to her poke.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule resistances-invalidated on Blooming Blows.
audit.corrected: Stated in breakdown.cooldowns and report[5] rather than in itemization, which keeps the fact next to the ability it belongs to.

edits.before: Weave passive autos between every spell. Trade around Blooming Blows and bank small HP leads — they compound at 6.
edits.after: Her speed only stacks while she moves — every W sweetspot or E cast freezes her, and that is your hook angle.

edits.before: Two items plus a stolen ult makes you a teamfight flex — flank, burst the carry, and steal the scariest R on cooldown.
edits.after: Two items and a stolen Lilting Lullaby make you a flex she cannot kite — your omnivamp eats the Dream Dust burn.

edits.before: - Lillia Blooming Blows: matchup-defining — Her kiting speed stacks — catch her early in the chase or not at all. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E1 shield for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Lillia Blooming Blows: matchup-defining — 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s, and the outer ring is true damage, so MR does not blunt her poke; she must stop moving to cast. - Budget E1 shield for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.

edits.before: Track Lillia’s Blooming Blows: Her kiting speed stacks — catch her early in the chase or not at all. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Lillia’s Blooming Blows: a 4-6s Q whose outer ring deals true damage, so MR will not blunt it. Her R is 150s at rank 1.

notes: Lillia is referred to as 'him/his' in tldr, winCon, ahead, tradeGood and several report entries while the content layer correctly uses 'her'. Champion-level copy issue across the full layer, not corrected here.
